name: Silhouette by The Zero Phuket
shortDescription: A boutique low-density condominium of 150 residences in Nai Yang, about 350 m from the beach, by UK developer The Zero.
description:
Silhouette by The Zero Phuket is a boutique, low-density condominium of 150 residences in Nai Yang, between Sirinat National Park and Nai Yang Beach. It is a condominium, not a villa project: the mix runs from studios to three-bedroom residences, with two-bedroom penthouse suites.

The developer, The Zero, is a UK company with an eco-smart building approach. A groundbreaking ceremony has been held and completion is quoted as the third quarter of 2028 (other listings say the second quarter).

Press coverage quotes prices from about 4.4 million baht. Ask us on WhatsApp for the current price list and which units remain.
